ops.oldText: for a period of [*] years from the Effective Date of this Agreement
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date of this Agreement

input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept this non-solicit only for a limited period, so we have set the restriction on IBM at twelve (12) months from the Effective Date; the existing multi-year term is longer than our policy permits. The narrow scope (Transferred Employees) and the unsolicited-approach and general-advertising carve-outs are acceptable as drafted, and we could live with an 18-month period if MSL needs more.
input.summary: Limit the non-solicit binding IBM to 12 months from the Effective Date.
